title: Where You Came From
label: ch:ml-ablative
canDo: I can ask where somebody is from and answer with any place I know.

payoff.summary: From cold: the from-word and what must precede it, the question it builds at no cost, and what a noun ending in -am does before any ending.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these three atoms and the payoff assesses all three. No new vocabulary at all: the place names come from chapter 80, evide from the deixis chapter, and the in-ending from the first verbs.
